thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty alert fired for service=auth-signing service_id=auth-primary env=prod — high error rate on /v1/token/verify (policy: P0)

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-8231 · Ack required from on-call. Escalation path: oncall -> sre -> eng-security.

oncall-alex: acked. Looking. seeing 5xx spike on verify across region-us-west-2. will gather logs.

sre-jordan: I’m seeing signature validation failures from multiple downstream services. errors look like "invalid signature" not timeout. Possible key mismatch or JWKS not updated. grabbing jwks logs now.

eng-security-lee: pinging key rotation system and KMS. Any recent changes to signing key TTL or deploys that touch the jwks endpoint?

oncall-alex: no deploys from auth team in last 2 hrs. jwks cache eviction happened 8m ago on a few instances per logs. but keys returned by jwks endpoint differ for kid values compared to what verifiers have. suspect propagation lag + caching.

product-support-zoe: Customer support queue: ~12 tickets from partners complaining tokens failing to validate, some 3rd-party integrations reporting 401s. Flagging high priority customers (tier: enterprise) — they’re hitting mass failures.

sre-jordan: quick sample from verifier logs: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z [verify] token_failure kid=abc123 expected_kid=def456 error=invalid_signature
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z [verify] token_failure kid=ghi789 expected_kid=ghi789 error=ok
```
So mixed results — some tokens validate, others don't. That matches a partial JWKS rotation where a subset of signing instances started issuing tokens signed with a new key that some verifiers haven't cached yet.

eng-security-lee: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert signing service to previous key (fast) 2) force JWKS version bump & invalidate caches (requires pushing cache invalidation to edge) 3) enable verifier fallback to fetch JWKS on cache miss (if not already)

oncall-alex: trying to force cache invalidation on a subset of verifier fleet (us-west-2) via remote command. running: 
```bash
# on verifier hosts
sudo systemctl restart verifier-cache && curl -sS https://auth.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys | wc -l
```
will update in 2-3m.

incident-bot: Pager duty note: oncall change scheduled. Handoff to oncall-maria in 20m if not resolved.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8231 acknowledged by oncall-alex. Escalating to eng-security-lee if not resolved in 10m.

oncall-maria: stepping in. Alex — status?

oncall-alex: evicted caches on 25% of verifiers in us-west-2, error rate dropped 40% there. global error rate still ~18%. logs still show mixed kid mismatch.

eng-security-lee: we should stop issuing tokens with the new kid until verifiers are fully refreshed. Rolling back the signer to last stable key now. I’ll coordinate with auth service.

sre-jordan: rolling back signer to key:def456-v2 on auth-primary. command: 
```bash
POST https://auth-control.redwood.ai/api/v1/signing/activate 
{ "key_id": "def456-v2" }
```
response: 200, propagation triggered.

oncall-maria: after rollback, monitoring — error rate trending down. still seeing stragglers from edge caches. recommend TTL reduce on jwks cache for 10m window.

eng-security-lee: pushing configuration: set Cache-Control: max-age=60 for jwks endpoint for the next 15m. also triggering explicit cache purge on CDN and internal caches.

product-support-zoe: relaying to support teams: hotfix in progress, customers with 401s should get updates in ~15m. adding note to status.redwood.ai (incidents page).

sre-jordan: verification snippet to validate current keys: 
```bash
TOKEN=eyJhbGci...
KID=$(jq -r '.kid' <(curl -s https://auth.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[0] | .kid'))
echo "current kid=$KID"
# run verifier locally to assert token verifies with current jwks
```
All green on local checks after rollback.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer paused — acknowledged and mitigation in progress.

incident-bot: NOTE: cross-service impact: badge: api-gateway, downstream: billing-worker, webhooks. Some retries caused duplicate webhook deliveries — watch idempotency.

oncall-alex: started a mitigation play: enable short-circuit validation path that forces JWKS fetch on every cache miss and logs misses to dd for audit. Deploying config change to verifiers now.

eng-security-lee: also recommend rotating the old key out only after ensuring all verifiers have the new jwks. Plan: 1) rollback signer (done) 2) shrink cache TTL to 60s (in flight) 3) monitor for 60m 4) after stable, reintroduce rotation with staged rollout.

oncall-maria: handoff summary for next shift: affected regions us-west-2 and global edge caches, root cause: partial JWKS rotation + cache eviction mismatch causing kid mismatch; mitigation: rolled back signer, reduced jwks TTL, CDN purge, verifier restart on subset, monitoring for duplicates in webhooks; customer comms posted. next steps: confirm <1% error for 30m before closing, coordinate full rotation with canary.

product-support-zoe: adding list of impacted customers to the incident doc and notifying enterprise CS leads.

sre-jordan: marking this thread with measured metrics: peak 5xx verify rate 23% at 10:12, current 1.7% at 10:41. will update if anything regresses.

oncall-alex: leaving detailed command logs in the incident ticket. handing to Maria at 10:45 — please escalate to eng-security if any regressions. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall-alex -> oncall-maria at 3370014500.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8231 status: mitigated, monitoring.

product-support-zoe: closing customer-facing note draft and scheduling follow-up postmortem with eng + security + support.

eng-security-lee: quick retrospective note: add a pre-rotation step to ensure cache invalidation paths are exercised and include a verification hook that fails rotation if >0.5% verifier failures observed during canary.

sre-jordan: agree. will add runbook steps and a checklist into the incident doc.

oncall-maria: thanks everyone. keeping monitoring until 11:15, will reopen if anything spikes. :handshake:
